# Single-five bounded requested-count evaluation contract

This protocol is for an explicitly requested skill experiment. It is not the default cost or workflow for ordinary poster work, and a PASS describes only the observed packet and version. Do not infer quality on unseen requests. Preserve every planned role, returned or failed native attempt, low score, raw review and procedural defect. Do not replace critics, drop requests, rename a role to reset its repair limit, or resample until PASS. Each candidate/version/case/role permits one initial native attempt plus at most two repairs, including failed attempts.

## Frozen input and complete viewing

Freeze a packet containing the exact user-requested N images before launching three fresh, independent critics. Do not silently expand an explicit one- or three-image request to five. Each critic evaluates the same ordered N members, each at native, usage720 and thumbnail320: all 3N exact views must be inspected before the first image score or diversity score. The current D1 case requests five and therefore still requires all fifteen views. Use the whole user request and each assigned style literally; do not infer the author's intent or translate an expressive genre into a safer genre. A first/final packet with any changed native hash requires a fresh complete three-critic evaluation. Reuse is allowed only when every member's native hash and the entire evaluation context are identical, with an explicit retained reference. A changed single image does not authorize partial reuse of the other members' scores.

The runner records launch/completion/JSONL trace evidence. Execution provenance can establish a fresh session, successful completion and immutable input/report bytes; it does not independently prove semantic image viewing. Each critic must also make a truthful viewing/order attestation. Do not claim a recognized image-view tool event unless the trace actually contains it. Unreadable or genuinely ambiguous views are NOT_ASSESSABLE (NA), not a guessed score or a fabricated glyph omission.

## Predeclared transcription

For every required copy entry, preserve the first raw observed text verbatim, the required literal text, the normalized comparison, layout observations and ambiguity separately. The normalization is `nfc-ws-optical-v1`:

- Apply Unicode NFC. Collapse each whitespace run to one ordinary space and trim outer whitespace. Preserve each explicit `\n` when `fixed_newlines:true`; collapse whitespace within each line, without merging lines. Otherwise a layout line break is whitespace, not a missing character.
- Preserve word spaces after that collapse. Do not erase all whitespace, invent a missing Hangul glyph from spacing alone, or merge differently spaced words to make equality pass.
- On `kind:"text"` entries only, remove optical spaces directly around the exact middle-dot `·` and slash `/`. Other punctuation characters remain distinct. URL entries must be separately declared `kind:"url"`; their slash, dot and word spacing receives no optical exception. A text entry containing a URL is an invalid packet, so a broken URL is never silently repaired by slash normalization.
- Record fixed-newline/layout fidelity separately from glyph/word/punctuation fidelity. Soft line wrapping and optical gaps are not evidence of a missing glyph. A genuine punctuation-class or glyph-class uncertainty is an ambiguity, not a definite transcription. Do not map a bullet, period, middle-dot, colon or lookalike to another punctuation class.

An ambiguity may trigger one revisit of the exact same pinned asset, never a regeneration. Preserve the initial read and the revisit `{view,path,sha256,raw_observed,resolution,resolved,reason}`. `resolution` explains the observed glyph class; `resolved` is a boolean. Use `revisit.raw_observed` for the final comparison only when `resolved:true`, while retaining the initial read unchanged. If `mandatory.text.ambiguities` is nonempty, each entry is `{copy_index,description,resolved}` and any claim of resolution must join the matching resolved transcription revisit. An unresolved ambiguity makes that image NA. No second revisit, repeated resampling, or retrospective change of the normalization rule is permitted.

## Packet schema

All paths are explicit existing file paths; hashes are lowercase SHA-256 of exact bytes. Relative paths resolve against the JSON file containing them. An input pin is `{path,sha256}`; an image-view pin also includes integer `width,height` matching its native-evidence manifest. Exactly N distinct image IDs and roles are mandatory. `expected_count` is the actual user's count, not a target invented by this protocol. An image may add `style_requirement` for its literal assigned direction; otherwise the common packet style is checked.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "case_id": "R7-C1", "wave": "initial",
  "expected_count": 5,
  "critic_profiles": ["A", "B", "C"],
  "full_request": "literal complete user request",
  "review_rules": {"path": "/absolute/review_rules.md", "sha256": "..."},
  "normalization": "nfc-ws-optical-v1",
  "copy": [{"text": "literal copy", "kind": "text", "fixed_newlines": false}],
  "requirements": {
    "style": "literal assigned style requirement, including clay3D and Hangul treatment where requested",
    "ratio": [3, 2], "no_type_only": true
  },
  "images": [{
    "image_id": "R7-C1-M1", "role": "R7-C1-M1", "stage": "initial",
    "source_manifest": {"path": "/absolute/stages/initial/manifest.json", "sha256": "..."},
    "views": {
      "native": {"path": "/absolute/original.png", "sha256": "...", "width": 1536, "height": 1024},
      "usage720": {"path": "/absolute/usage-720.png", "sha256": "...", "width": 720, "height": 480},
      "thumbnail320": {"path": "/absolute/thumbnail-320.png", "sha256": "...", "width": 320, "height": 213}
    }
  }]
}
```

The example shows one member for brevity; a packet declaring `expected_count:5` must contain exactly five. Packets for explicit one- or three-image requests declare 1 or 3. Seven dimensions are exactly `content_form`, `hierarchy`, `typography`, `space`, `image_material`, `emotion_control`, `ai_slop`.

## Raw critic JSON schema

One untouched JSON and Markdown report per critic. Do not let a combiner rewrite a raw review. `session_id` may be `null` when it is not observable inside the critic; the summarizer derives it from the actual runner trace. A non-null claimed ID must match. Evidence entries are `{view,location,observation}` with a named pinned view, a concrete location and an observed fact. Scores are integers 1–5, never booleans or numeric strings. Every dimension requires located evidence. A high average cannot cancel any low dimension or mandatory failure.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1, "case_id": "R7-C1", "wave": "initial", "profile": "A", "session_id": null,
  "procedure": {"fresh_session": true, "all_views_before_scoring": true, "viewed_count": 15, "order_compliant": true, "method": "truthful description of exact viewing"},
  "viewed": [{"image_id": "R7-C1-M1", "view": "native", "path": "/absolute/original.png", "sha256": "..."}],
  "images": {"R7-C1-M1": {
    "image_id": "R7-C1-M1", "role": "R7-C1-M1", "stage": "initial", "case_id": "R7-C1", "profile": "A",
    "mandatory": {
      "text": {"status": "PASS", "issues": [], "ambiguities": [], "transcriptions": [{
        "required": "literal copy", "raw_observed": "literal copy",
        "normalized_required": "literal copy", "normalized_observed": "literal copy", "equal": true,
        "layout": {"status": "PASS", "observations": "soft wrapping or fixed newlines observed separately"},
        "ambiguity": null, "revisit": null
      }]},
      "style": {"status": "PASS", "checked_requirement": "same literal packet style requirement", "evidence": [{"view": "native", "location": "...", "observation": "..."}], "issues": []},
      "ratio": {"status": "PASS", "observed_dimensions": [1536, 1024], "issues": []},
      "no_type_only": {"status": "PASS", "evidence": [{"view": "native", "location": "...", "observation": "substantive nonglyph scene/action/form that contributes to the requested message"}], "issues": []},
      "substantive_visual": {"status": "PASS", "evidence": [{"view": "native", "location": "...", "observation": "..."}]}
    },
    "scores": {"content_form": 4, "hierarchy": 4, "typography": 4, "space": 4, "image_material": 4, "emotion_control": 4, "ai_slop": 4},
    "evidence": {"content_form": [{"view": "native", "location": "...", "observation": "..."}], "hierarchy": [], "typography": [], "space": [], "image_material": [], "emotion_control": [], "ai_slop": []},
    "residuals": []
  }},
  "set": {"members": ["R7-C1-M1", "R7-C1-M2", "R7-C1-M3", "R7-C1-M4", "R7-C1-M5"], "requested_count": 5,
    "count_fidelity": {"status": "PASS", "observed_count": 5, "required_count": 5, "issues": []}, "diversity": 4,
    "evidence": [{"image_id": "R7-C1-M1", "view": "thumbnail320", "location": "whole composition", "observation": "specific relationship to the other four"}], "residuals": []}
}
```

Populate all 3N `viewed` entries, all N `images`, all seven nonempty evidence arrays per image, and (when N>=2) diversity evidence naming every member. For N=1, set `diversity:null` and `not_applicable_reason:"single requested image"`; do not fabricate a diversity score or turn this omission into a failed gate. Explicit count fidelity is mandatory for all N. Examples are structural, not default scores. Mandatory status is exactly `PASS`, `FAIL` or `NA`. A type or whitespace composition plus a tiny ornament does not meet `no_type_only`: the required nonglyph visual must be substantive. Material polish alone cannot replace the requested scene, action or genre. If the required ratio or copy is demonstrably wrong, report FAIL. If the exact asset cannot be judged, report NA and its reason. Do not use NA to hide an observed low score.

## Runner provenance and summary gates

`summarize.py --packet PACKET --report A=RAW_A --report B=RAW_B --report C=RAW_C --completions-dir ROOT --output NEW_OUTPUT` reads `ROOT/PROFILE/launch.json` and `completion.json` for each profile. Launch contains `started_utc,argv,fresh_session:true,case_id,wave,profile,prompt:{path,sha256},input_pins:[{path,sha256}]`. Completion preserves those fields and adds `completed_utc,exit_code,session_ids,turn_completed_count,input_pins_unchanged,trace:{path,sha256},reports:{"A.json":{path,sha256},"A.md":{path,sha256}}`. The actual `thread.started` trace ID is the session identity. Require `exec --ephemeral`, no resume/fork, exactly one fresh thread, at least one completed turn, exit zero, immutable declared inputs and raw report pins, and three unique sessions. Packet, rules and all 3N views must be launch input pins.

Each image PASS requires all seven scores >=4 from each of the three critics, each critic's mandatory text/style/ratio/no-type-only/substantive-visual PASS, and valid unambiguous evidence. Set PASS additionally requires exact count fidelity, every requested image gate PASS, and (for N>=2) diversity >=4 from all three critics. The five-member diversity threshold is unchanged. Invalid procedure, inconsistent recorded equality, missing evidence or unresolved actual ambiguity yields NA with the raw low records retained. A valid observed low score or mandatory failure yields FAIL. There is no mean-score gate.

The exclusive output contains every requested image gate, each critic's seven raw scores, mandatory/transcription data, raw report data and byte pins, source/view/manifest pins, procedure errors, all three diversity values (or explicit single-image applicability exclusions), and exact expected/observed record and score counts. One N-image stage has 3N image/profile records and 21N declared score slots. D1's five-image stage has fifteen records and 105 slots; two actually evaluated D1 stages have thirty records and 210 slots. Do not claim those totals for missing/invalid/raw-unreadable records.

## Native evidence helper

Before every native call create `ROLE_DIR/stages/STAGE/call-input.json` and `pre-call.json`; when they contain `role`/`stage`, identities must match. Save the complete actual tool input and recorded pre-call evidence before starting. Do not retrofit them after viewing the outcome. After a returned native call:

```sh
python3 evidence_io.py save-native --role R7-C1-M1 --stage initial --source /exact/returned/native.png --role-dir /absolute/role-dir
```

The helper preserves native bytes as `original.png` and `final.png`, makes only Pillow QA downsampling, and writes `manifest.json` with source/input/artifact hashes and PNG dimensions. `saved_at_utc` is helper preservation time, not a claimed tool interval. The caller retains actual native start/end/tool-result evidence; do not infer native concurrency from helper process intervals or filenames.

Every returned stage needs `inspection.json` with `{role,stage,actual_viewed:true,actual_view_paths:[exact original, exact usage720, exact thumbnail320],raw_observed_text:[],residuals:[]}`. Each returned repair also needs `parent-comparison.json` identifying the immediate parent stage/outcome, its `parent_manifest_sha256` and `parent_native_sha256` (or `parent_failure_sha256`), plus `changes:[]` and `residuals:[]`. Failed calls need `{role,stage,outcome:"failure",native_call_count:1,error:"actual recorded failure"}` in `failure.json`; keep their input, pre-call and failure metadata. They count toward the three-call cap and are not selectable.

`python3 evidence_io.py finalize --role-dir ROLE_DIR --selected-stage initial|repair-1|repair-2` verifies every stage and inspection, retains unselected and failed stages, and creates an exclusive `selection.json`. It refuses missing outcomes, overwrites, gaps and more than two repairs. No helper actually views, visually rescales scores, or generates images. Use later unseen requests as a frozen transfer test after development; do not feed their critic results back into that frozen candidate or claim this experiment proves all future requests high-end.

# Prospective recording v2 for R10

Freeze this physically separate method before any R10 production. It supports both literal `initial` and `selected` phases using one identical helper chain. The actual compact raw schema remains 1; packet `compact_recording.schema_version` is 2 with `pin_schema:path-sha256-bytes-v2`. No R9 raw record, missing export, prior quality score, CLI actor, or archived evidence is rewritten or rescored. This method launches no production or review.

The adapter and audit byte reader consistently retain exact `path`, `sha256`, and `bytes` pins. Raw packet pins must equal that exact three-field pin. Any supplied byte count is validated as an exact integer. The unchanged runner's launch/completion and projected source-asset fields may remain path/hash-only receipts; the audit verifies exact bytes and returns actual byte counts. The preparer explicitly loads its sibling auditor, and the auditor explicitly loads its sibling adapter, so same-name ROOT or cached prior-method helpers cannot shadow the frozen method.

The adapter's assessment, normalization, export, and rendering functions are unchanged from the R9 recording v2 source. All frozen v4 rubric, seven score dimensions/floors, source/ratio/copy/mandatory judgments, full-count/diversity gates, exact first reading and one-revisit rules, complete-view ordering, finite review and whole-context reuse restrictions, and effective NA behavior remain unchanged. Root supplies the base producer/evaluation helpers and freezes their exact bytes together with runtime J before production.

# Compact critic recording contract

Only metadata-only fixture jobs are created by verification. No real case preparation, critic, image, or actor is launched here. Declare and freeze this method together with the new runtime before any production. Use its exact frozen helper paths for both initial and selected review preparation.

Each of the three fresh independent critics would write one immutable `PROFILE.observations.json`. The critic supplies actual first-read text, separate layout observations, ambiguity/revisit, all mandatory judgments, seven integer scores and located evidence per image, and full-set diversity with evidence for every member. The adapter derives repeated identities, required-copy strings, normalization/equality, literal checked styles, packet dimensions, and standard JSON/Markdown presentation. It never derives a score, replaces an observed string with required copy, averages, drops members, selects critics, generates images, or edits native pixels. All existing v4 thresholds and procedural gates remain.

## Compact raw fields

The validated format is `schema_version:1`, `kind:"compact_critic_observations"`, the packet's `case_id/wave`, the assigned `profile`, `session_id:null`, and `packet:{path,sha256,bytes}`. Record all five image IDs exactly once in `images` and all fifteen attempted poster views in `viewed`, ordered by packet member then `native/usage720/thumbnail320`. Each view receipt contains `image_id,view,path,sha256,viewed`; an unavailable view has `viewed:false` and a reason. Preserve an unknown raw path rather than guessing a replacement. Actual missing views or mismatched bindings cannot become a successful viewing/order attestation.

`procedure` contains truthful `fresh_session`, `all_views_before_scoring`, `order_compliant`, `method`, `source_assets_viewed`, and `protected_layouts_read`. Sources and protected-layout manifests must be viewed/read before source fidelity judgments; all fifteen poster views precede the first judgment, image score, or set score. Receipts identify every exact pinned source asset (`asset_id,path,sha256,viewed`) and protected manifest (`manifest:{path,sha256},read`). An unavailable source/manifest requires a reason. Empty source arrays are explicit when no sources exist. These receipts are semantic attestations, not invented tool events.

Each image record contains:

- `copy`: one entry per required string, in packet order, with `raw` as the untouched actual first read (an empty string is allowed when nothing can be read), `layout:{status,observations}`, `ambiguity` as a description or null, and `revisit` as null or the existing one-revisit object (`view,path,sha256,raw_observed,resolved,reason,resolution`). First read is retained even after a resolved revisit. No required or normalized strings are written by the critic.
- `mandatory`: exactly `text/style/ratio/no_type_only/substantive_visual`; each includes the critic's actual `status:PASS|FAIL|NA` and any `issues`. Style, no-type-only, and substantive-visual include nonempty compact evidence. Text status must honestly match the retained reading, layout, issues, and ambiguity; the frozen summary checks this without adapter repair. The style judgment covers every literal condition and any applicable source identity/protected geometry, rather than maker intent.
- `ratings`: exactly the seven existing dimensions, each `{score,evidence}`. A score is an integer 1–5. An unjudgable value is `null` with a reason; v4 will preserve it and classify the affected record NA rather than inventing a number. Evidence is a list of `[view,location,observation]` tuples; even an unavailable judgment must locate the limitation honestly.
- `source_fidelity`: one `{asset_id,status,observations}` per source, explaining its user-assigned identity/style/composition role and any protected boundaries, relative position/size, and crop. Unknown/unviewed source pixels or unread protected geometry receive NA; definite observable violations receive FAIL. Required-source FAIL must appear in mandatory style FAIL; source NA cannot become style PASS. A style-only reference does not impose geometry it was never asked to preserve.
- `residuals`: concrete remaining limits, including low findings.

`set` contains the five ordered `members`, `count_fidelity:{status,observed_count,issues}`, the critic's independent integer `diversity` (or unjudgable null with a reason), `evidence` tuples `[image_id,view,location,observation]` covering all five, and `residuals`. These judgments are retained. Do not prefill scores or infer diversity from material labels.

## Dimensions, paths, and compatibility

All native dimensions and ratios come from the exact future packet; no portrait or 2:3 assumption is present. A landscape 16:9 poster is supported. `usage720` means width <=720 preserving aspect, without upsampling; `thumbnail320` means maximum edge <=320. The method does not create those views or resize images. The frozen summary independently verifies view/manifest/source hashes and PNG dimensions. If a raw return path or exact source cannot be located, preserve that missing binding and NA; do not recover it by newest-file scanning, a substitute crop, or another generation. For a future declared run, pin this adapter and method instructions as launch inputs alongside the unchanged rubric/rules, packet, all exact poster views, supplied sources, and layout manifests. Inside each fresh critic session, first exclusively write its compact observation JSON, then call:

```sh

The adapter exclusively creates `PROFILE.json` and `PROFILE.md`, refuses overwrites and incomplete member/evidence schemas, and binds the compact raw file and adapter hashes in the compatibility export. It does not make the raw observation record disappear or turn derived fields into independent observations.

The existing v4 summary does not independently validate the adapter/raw-observation link or source-fidelity extension; future launch inputs/completion pins and the already required source-attestation audit must preserve those bindings. Adapter errors retain the original raw file and are procedural NA, not permission to edit it or rerun a critic. The future critic instructions must explicitly authorize its compact raw file plus two deterministic exports: the frozen R8 rubric's two-output instruction must not be silently reinterpreted.

## Verification limit

`test_selected_recording_v2.py` uses temporary text metadata fixtures, with maker inventory and PNG validation explicitly mocked. It invokes the actual new preparer, uses its exact job/prompt/raw packet schema, runs the real adapter through a shell, and validates three synthetic CLI metadata records plus explicit archive-reader replay. URL = re.compile(r"(?i)(?:https?://|www\.)\S+")
SUMMARY_SHA256 = "4c5dc9847694b4cfe1744115ff1a79e9e7e9d5c71abea38b7f3250600c2144e0"


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def pin(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data)}


def load_json(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return json.loads(data), {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data)}


def normalize(raw, entry):
    """Frozen v4 NFC/whitespace/optical policy; raw input remains untouched."""
    require(isinstance(raw, str), "Actual raw reading must be a string; no fallback from required copy")
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", raw.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n"))
    if entry["fixed_newlines"]:
        value = "\n".join(re.sub(r"[^\S\n]+", " ", line).strip() for line in value.split("\n"))
    else:
        value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()
    if entry["kind"] == "text":
        pieces, previous = [], 0
        for match in URL.finditer(value):
            pieces.append(re.sub(r" *([·/]) *", r"\1", value[previous:match.start()]))
            pieces.append(match.group())
            previous = match.end()
        pieces.append(re.sub(r" *([·/]) *", r"\1", value[previous:]))
        value = "".join(pieces)
    return value


def evidence(items, members=None):
    """Compact tuples: [view, location, observation], or [image_id, view, location, observation]."""
    require(isinstance(items, list) and bool(items), "Located evidence must be nonempty")
    result = []
    for item in items:
        require(isinstance(item, list) and len(item) == (4 if members is not None else 3), "Invalid evidence tuple")
        image_id, tail = (item[0], item[1:]) if members is not None else (None, item)
        view, location, observation = tail
        require(view in VIEWS and isinstance(location, str) and location.strip() and isinstance(observation, str) and observation.strip(), "Evidence needs a named view, location and observed fact")
        row = {"view": view, "location": location, "observation": observation}
        if members is not None:
            require(image_id in members, "Set evidence must name a requested member")
            row["image_id"] = image_id
        result.append(row)
    return result


def checked_status(data):
    require(isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("status") in STATUSES, "Every mandatory judgment needs explicit PASS/FAIL/NA")
    require(isinstance(data.get("issues", []), list), "Issues must be an array")
    return copy.deepcopy(data)


def export(packet, raw, *, packet_pin=None, raw_pin=None, adapter_pin=None):
    """Derive repeated metadata only; retain critic strings, judgments, scores and low values."""
    require(packet.get("normalization") == NORMALIZATION, "Normalization must be predeclared")
    require(type(packet.get("expected_count")) is int and packet["expected_count"] == 5, "This method is bounded to one complete five-image request")
    images = packet.get("images", [])
    ids = [image["image_id"] for image in images]
    require(len(ids) == 5 and len(set(ids)) == 5, "Exactly five distinct packet members required")
    require(type(raw.get("schema_version")) is int and raw["schema_version"] == 1 and raw.get("kind") == "compact_critic_observations", "Compact schema version/kind required")
    for key in ("case_id", "wave"):
        require(raw.get(key) == packet.get(key), f"Raw {key} differs from packet")
    profile = raw.get("profile")
    require(profile in packet.get("critic_profiles", []), "Profile must be one declared independent critic")
    require(raw.get("session_id") is None, "Runner, not adapter, binds actual session identity")
    if packet_pin is not None:
        require(raw.get("packet") == packet_pin, "Raw observations must bind the exact input packet")
    require(isinstance(raw.get("images"), dict) and set(raw["images"]) == set(ids), "All five raw records required; no extra/dropped member")
    expected = [(image["image_id"], view) for image in images for view in VIEWS]
    visits = raw.get("viewed")
    require(isinstance(visits, list) and [(v.get("image_id"), v.get("view")) for v in visits] == expected, "All fifteen attempted views must remain in exact packet order")
    procedure = copy.deepcopy(raw.get("procedure"))
    require(isinstance(procedure, dict) and all(type(procedure.get(k)) is bool for k in ("fresh_session", "all_views_before_scoring", "order_compliant")), "Truthful procedure booleans required")
    require(isinstance(procedure.get("method"), str) and procedure["method"].strip(), "Actual method description required")
    binding_errors, viewed = [], []
    by_id = {image["image_id"]: image for image in images}
    for visit in visits:
        require(type(visit.get("viewed")) is bool, "Every view needs an actual viewed boolean")
        require(isinstance(visit.get("path"), str) and isinstance(visit.get("sha256"), str), "Retain supplied/unknown raw path and hash; do not invent one")
        target = by_id[visit["image_id"]]["views"][visit["view"]]
        if (visit["path"], visit["sha256"]) != (target["path"], target["sha256"]):
            binding_errors.append(f"{visit['image_id']}/{visit['view']}: raw path/hash does not match exact packet view")
        if visit["viewed"]:
            viewed.append({k: visit[k] for k in ("image_id", "view", "path", "sha256")})
        else:
            require(isinstance(visit.get("reason"), str) and visit["reason"].strip(), "Unavailable view needs an honest reason")
    # These two fields are mechanical counts/order bindings, never fabricated opens.
    procedure["viewed_count"] = len(viewed)
    if binding_errors:
        procedure["order_compliant"] = False
    procedure["adapter_binding_errors"] = binding_errors
    assets = packet.get("source_assets", [])
    source_visits = procedure.get("source_assets_viewed")
    layout_reads = procedure.get("protected_layouts_read")
    require(isinstance(source_visits, list) and isinstance(layout_reads, list), "Source view/layout read receipts required, including empty arrays")
    require(len(source_visits) == len(assets) and len({v.get('asset_id') for v in source_visits}) == len(assets), "One receipt for each actual source asset required")
    source_by_id = {asset["asset_id"]: asset for asset in assets}
    missing_sources = set()
    for receipt in source_visits:
        asset = source_by_id.get(receipt.get("asset_id"))
        require(asset is not None and type(receipt.get("viewed")) is bool, "Unknown/duplicate source receipt")
        matching = (receipt.get("path"), receipt.get("sha256")) == (asset["actual_path"], asset["sha256"])
        if not matching or not receipt["viewed"]:
            missing_sources.add(asset["asset_id"])
            require(isinstance(receipt.get("reason"), str) and receipt["reason"].strip(), "Unassessable source needs a reason")
    expected_layouts = { (x["manifest"]["path"], x["manifest"]["sha256"]): x["asset_id"] for x in packet.get("protected_layouts", []) }
    require(len(layout_reads) == len(expected_layouts), "Each protected-layout manifest needs one read receipt")
    seen_layouts = set()
    for receipt in layout_reads:
        manifest = receipt.get("manifest", {})
        key = (manifest.get("path"), manifest.get("sha256"))
        require(key in expected_layouts and key not in seen_layouts and type(receipt.get("read")) is bool, "Read receipts must bind exact protected manifests")
        seen_layouts.add(key)
        if not receipt["read"]:
            missing_sources.add(expected_layouts[key])
            require(isinstance(receipt.get("reason"), str) and receipt["reason"].strip(), "Unread protected layout needs a reason")
    result = {"schema_version": 1, "case_id": packet["case_id"], "wave": packet["wave"], "profile": profile,
              "session_id": None, "procedure": procedure, "viewed": viewed, "images": {},
              "recording_adapter": {"kind": "declared_deterministic_export", "normalization": NORMALIZATION,
                                    "packet": packet_pin, "raw_observations": raw_pin, "adapter": adapter_pin,
                                    "compatible_summary_sha256": SUMMARY_SHA256,
                                    "limit": "Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity"}}
    for image in images:
        iid, observation = image["image_id"], raw["images"][image["image_id"]]
        mandatory = observation.get("mandatory")
        require(isinstance(mandatory, dict) and set(mandatory) == {"text", "style", "ratio", "no_type_only", "substantive_visual"}, "All five mandatory judgments required")
        checks = {name: checked_status(data) for name, data in mandatory.items()}
        for name, check in checks.items():
            allowed = {"status", "issues", "evidence"} if name in ("style", "no_type_only", "substantive_visual") else {"status", "issues"}
            require(not (set(check) - allowed), "Repeated export fields must not replace a critic's extra raw judgments; use the compact schema")
        rows = observation.get("copy")
        require(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == len(packet["copy"]), "Every first-read copy entry required")
        transcripts, ambiguities = [], []
        for index, (entry, reading) in enumerate(zip(packet["copy"], rows)):
            require(isinstance(reading, dict) and set(reading) == {"raw", "layout", "ambiguity", "revisit"}, "Compact reading needs raw/layout/ambiguity/revisit only")
            first = reading.get("raw")
            require(isinstance(first, str), "Never fill missing raw reading from required copy")
            layout = reading.get("layout")
            require(isinstance(layout, dict) and layout.get("status") in STATUSES and isinstance(layout.get("observations"), str) and layout["observations"].strip(), "Separate actual layout observation required")
            ambiguity, revisit = reading.get("ambiguity"), reading.get("revisit")
            require(ambiguity is None or isinstance(ambiguity, str) and bool(ambiguity.strip()), "Ambiguity must be explicit or null")
            comparison = first
            if revisit is not None:
                require(ambiguity and isinstance(revisit, dict) and revisit.get("view") in VIEWS and type(revisit.get("resolved")) is bool and isinstance(revisit.get("raw_observed"), str), "Only one ambiguity-triggered exact-view revisit permitted")
                target = image["views"][revisit["view"]]
                require((revisit.get("path"), revisit.get("sha256")) == (target["path"], target["sha256"]), "Revisit must use the same pinned asset")
                require(all(isinstance(revisit.get(k), str) and revisit[k].strip() for k in ("reason", "resolution")), "Revisit needs reason and resolution explanation")
                if revisit["resolved"]:
                    comparison = revisit["raw_observed"]
            nr, no = normalize(entry["text"], entry), normalize(comparison, entry)
            transcripts.append({"required": entry["text"], "raw_observed": first, "normalized_required": nr,
                                "normalized_observed": no, "equal": nr == no, "layout": copy.deepcopy(layout),
                                "ambiguity": ambiguity, "revisit": copy.deepcopy(revisit)})
            if ambiguity:
                ambiguities.append({"copy_index": index, "description": ambiguity, "resolved": bool(revisit and revisit["resolved"])})
        checks["text"].update(transcriptions=transcripts, ambiguities=ambiguities)
        checks["text"].setdefault("issues", [])
        checks["style"]["checked_requirement"] = image.get("style_requirement", packet["requirements"]["style"])
        for name in ("style", "no_type_only", "substantive_visual"):
            checks[name]["evidence"] = evidence(checks[name].get("evidence"))
        native = image["views"]["native"]
        checks["ratio"]["observed_dimensions"] = [native["width"], native["height"]]
        checks["ratio"]["dimension_source"] = "exact packet native-view metadata; frozen summary independently checks native PNG header"
        ratings = observation.get("ratings")
        require(isinstance(ratings, dict) and set(ratings) == set(DIMENSIONS), "All seven ratings required")
        scores, located = {}, {}
        for dimension in DIMENSIONS:
            rating = ratings[dimension]
            score = rating.get("score")
            require(score is None or type(score) is int and 1 <= score <= 5, "Score must be an actual integer 1–5 or honest unjudgable null")
            if score is None:
                require(isinstance(rating.get("reason"), str) and rating["reason"].strip(), "Unjudgable null score needs a reason")
            scores[dimension] = score
            located[dimension] = evidence(rating.get("evidence"))
        fidelity = observation.get("source_fidelity")
        require(isinstance(fidelity, list) and len(fidelity) == len(assets) and {f.get("asset_id") for f in fidelity} == set(source_by_id), "Explicit identity/applicable protected-geometry fidelity for every source required")
        require(len({f.get("asset_id") for f in fidelity}) == len(fidelity), "Duplicate source-fidelity record")
        for judgment in fidelity:
            require(judgment.get("status") in STATUSES and isinstance(judgment.get("observations"), str) and judgment["observations"].strip(), "Actual source/geometry assessment or NA explanation required")
            require(judgment["asset_id"] not in missing_sources or judgment["status"] == "NA", "Unknown/unviewed source or unread protected geometry cannot earn fidelity PASS")
        source_states = {judgment["status"] for judgment in fidelity}
        if "FAIL" in source_states:
            require(checks["style"]["status"] == "FAIL", "Literal style/conditions must include observed source-preservation failure")
        elif "NA" in source_states:
            require(checks["style"]["status"] in ("NA", "FAIL"), "Unassessable required source preservation cannot become style PASS")
        require(isinstance(observation.get("residuals"), list), "Residuals array required")
        result["images"][iid] = {"image_id": iid, "role": image["role"], "stage": image["stage"],
                                 "case_id": packet["case_id"], "profile": profile, "mandatory": checks,
                                 "scores": scores, "evidence": located, "residuals": copy.deepcopy(observation["residuals"]),
                                 "source_fidelity": copy.deepcopy(fidelity),
                                 "unjudgable_score_reasons": {d: ratings[d]["reason"] for d in DIMENSIONS if scores[d] is None}}
    group = copy.deepcopy(raw.get("set"))
    require(isinstance(group, dict) and group.get("members") == ids, "Full ordered five-member set required")
    count = group.get("count_fidelity")
    require(isinstance(count, dict) and count.get("status") in STATUSES and type(count.get("observed_count")) is int and isinstance(count.get("issues"), list), "Actual count judgment required")
    count["required_count"] = packet["expected_count"]
    diversity = group.get("diversity")
    require(diversity is None or type(diversity) is int and 1 <= diversity <= 5, "Actual full-set diversity integer or unjudgable null required")
    if diversity is None:
        require(isinstance(group.get("reason"), str) and group["reason"].strip(), "Unjudgable diversity needs a reason")
    group["evidence"] = evidence(group.get("evidence"), ids)
    require({e["image_id"] for e in group["evidence"]} == set(ids), "Diversity evidence must cover all five")
    require(isinstance(group.get("residuals"), list), "Set residuals array required")
    group["requested_count"] = packet["expected_count"]
    result["set"] = group
    return result


def markdown(report):
    lines = [f"# {report['profile']} — deterministic compatibility export", "",
             "Raw observations, their pin, and the declared adapter remain separate. No scores or observations were authored by this renderer.", "",
             f"Procedure: {json.dumps(report['procedure'], ensure_ascii=False)}", ""]
    for iid, row in report["images"].items():
        lines += [f"## {iid}", "", f"Mandatory: {json.dumps(row['mandatory'], ensure_ascii=False)}", ""]
        for dimension in DIMENSIONS:
            lines += [f"- {dimension}: {row['scores'][dimension]} — {json.dumps(row['evidence'][dimension], ensure_ascii=False)}"]
        lines += ["", f"Source fidelity: {json.dumps(row['source_fidelity'], ensure_ascii=False)}",
                  f"Residuals: {json.dumps(row['residuals'], ensure_ascii=False)}", ""]
    lines += ["## Complete set", "", json.dumps(report["set"], ensure_ascii=False), "",
              "## Recording provenance", "", json.dumps(report["recording_adapter"], ensure_ascii=False), ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--packet", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--observations", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(args.output_dir.is_dir(), "Use the already designated critic output directory; no job/directory creation")
    packet, packet_pin = load_json(args.packet)
    raw, raw_pin = load_json(args.observations)
    report = export(packet, raw, packet_pin=packet_pin, raw_pin=raw_pin, adapter_pin=pin(__file__))
    profile = report["profile"]
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", profile) is not None, "Invalid profile filename")
    targets = [args.output_dir / f"{profile}.json", args.output_dir / f"{profile}.md"]
    require(all(not path.exists() for path in targets), "Compatibility outputs are exclusive; no raw/report overwrite")
    with targets[0].open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(report, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        handle.write("\n")
    with targets[1].open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(markdown(report))
    require(pin(args.observations) == report["recording_adapter"]["raw_observations"], "Raw observations changed during export")
    require(pin(args.packet) == packet_pin, "Input packet changed during export")
    print(json.dumps({"derived_reports": [pin(path) for path in targets], "raw_observations": pin(args.observations)}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
